# SI030 — too-many-nondet-blocks

Keep adjudication to at most three non-deterministic blocks.

## Why

Each block multiplies validator work. Split evidence verification from clause evaluation when the budget is exceeded.

## Bad

```python
evaluate_a(); evaluate_b(); evaluate_c(); evaluate_d()
```

## Good

```python
one block: fetch + clause loop + aggregate
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI030 -- reason
```
